source.version: Part 14 — Abiotic Disorders and Diagnostic Reasoning — Batch 03
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-271–275 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 14 manuscript plus controlled cannabis vegetative light-intensity data, a recent controlled cannabis relative-humidity study, plant hypoxia mechanisms with cannabis hydroponic oxygen-control context, direct drug-type cannabis and hemp salinity studies, and medical-cannabis phosphorus/root-zone nutrition evidence. Public wording rejects universal stretch, VPD, dissolved-oxygen, salinity/EC, and pH-lockout thresholds and keeps measurement method, genotype, stage, root condition, and competing causes explicit.
source.note: This batch publishes low-light etiolation/stretch, humidity/transpiration imbalance, root-zone hypoxia, salinity/osmotic stress, and pH-driven nutrient unavailability.
